item.title: How much will an average commute cost drivers using I-485 Express Lanes?
item.description: Drivers commuting on the I-485 express lanes in south Charlotte should expect to pay at least $8.20 in tolls one-way, with an average weekly cost of $100 and a monthly cost of up to $400, depending on the time of day and day of the week.

item.title: How do sheriff's offices in the Charlotte area work with ICE?
item.description: CHARLOTTE, N.C. (QUEEN CITY NEWS) -- Ten sheriff's offices in the Charlotte area have agreements with ICE to help federal agents enforce immigration. The counties include Cabarrus, Caldwell, Catawba, Cleveland, Gaston, Lincoln and Union in North Carolina and Chester, Lancaster and York in South Carolina.
